IDENT.title: A CPPS-architecture and workflow for bringing agent-based technologies as a form of artificial intelligence into practice

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: An IA is an intelligent entity used for distributed problem-solving in automation, typically characterized as autonomous, collaborative, and communicative (from IEEE 2660.1 [11]); also 'Each IA is a virtual decision-making entity that can sense, process, store, or act on any CPPS shop floor.'
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: Each IA is a virtual decision-making entity that can sense, process, store, or act on any CPPS shop floor.

A_DEFINITION__definition_source.evidence_quote: an IA is an intelligent entity used for distributed problem-solving in automation, typically characterized as autonomous, collaborative, and communicative [11]

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: Multi-Agent Systems (MASs) consist out of Industrial Agents (IAs)

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: Class I refers to Physical access agent, Class II to Organizational agent, Class III to Interface agent, and Class IV to Human agent.
